Members

(module scope)

RGB channel triple in 0–1 space.

rgbOf

Unpacks a packed hex color into a normalized channel triple — pure math (no THREE.Color) so the identical code path runs inside the decode workers.

  • @param hex Packed color int.

lerpRgb

Linear channel-triple lerp.

spectralColor

Converts a B-V colour index into an [r,g,b] triple in 0–1 space. The HYG ci column runs roughly −0.4 (hot O stars) to +2.0 (cool M dwarfs); four tokenized stops interpolate linearly between spectral tints so no hardcoded colours leak into the loop.

  • @param ci B-V colour index of the star.
  • @returns [r,g,b] in linear 0–1 range.

decodeRange

Decodes one record range of the packed deep-field binary into pos/col buffers — identical math to the SF_DECODE_DEEPFIELD worker handler so a chunk computed locally is indistinguishable from a worker result. Records: kind 0 — HYG stars (galactic heliocentric xyz), kind 1 — NASA Exoplanet Archive planets, kind 2 — OpenNGC deep-sky objects. Positions convert heliocentric light-years to chart units through the shared sfChartDist three-tier compression; vertex colour follows the B-V spectral ramp for stars and kind tints for planets/DSOs.

  • @param f32 Record view (x,y,z,mag,ci,kind ×N).
  • @param pos xyz buffer — compacted output from index 0.
  • @param col rgb buffer (same).
  • @param i0 First record index.
  • @param i1 One past the last record index.
  • @returns Live record count written (sentinel drops compact out).

buildCloud

Builds the deep-field Points object from decoded buffers — one vertex per catalogued object, vertex-colored by spectral ramp/kind tint and magnitude. The decode itself runs chunked across the WASM worker pool (SF_DECODE_DEEPFIELD) with decodeRange as the identical local fallback.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param pos Decoded xyz buffer.
  • @param col Decoded rgb buffer.
  • @returns The Points object.

ensureStarCloud

Lazy-loads the real star field once per boot — fired fire-and-forget from bootstrap after the body graph exists, so the 1.5 MB binary streams in the background and the cloud fades in on the disc when it decodes. The record decode dispatches chunked through the WASM worker pool (the raw payload rides structuredClone so the main thread keeps its buffer for the identical local fallback). No-ops on repeat calls, dispose, or fetch failure.

  • @param s Star engine state bag.
  • @param THREE The three.js module (lazy-loaded by bootstrap).

disposeStarCloud

Disposes the cloud geometry/material on engine teardown so a hot reload does not leak the 78k-point buffers.

  • @param s Star engine state bag.
